current_activity: command post at Petershausen as the division approaches Munich from the northwest
notes: Event date: 29 April 1945 (CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 20th Armored Division: Petershausen on 29 Apr 45; Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 436: with the 20th Armored and the 42d and 45th Divisions approaching the city from the northwest and north, General Patch altered corps boundaries to put the 3d Division temporarily under the XV Corps for the assault on Munich). Event definition: the division command post is about 35 km north-northwest of Munich on the day before the city falls. Relationship: XV Corps unspecified_subordination (from 23 Apr 45, CMH table); Seventh Army assigned (from 23 Apr 45, CMH table); 6th Army Group assigned (from 23 Apr 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Petershausen (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R573 p. 556: listed 29 April 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Petershausen. Event support: moderate (one Green Book passage and the CMH table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).
